summary: Operate a media player (play/pause/seek; + at timestamp/quality/subtitle)
preconditions: The browser is on a page containing an audio or video media player.
steps: Locate the media player interface on the page.
If specific playback settings are requested (such as speed, quality, or subtitles), locate and adjust those controls first (e.g., select a speed from a dropdown, toggle subtitles).
If a specific starting timestamp is requested, click or drag the progress/seek bar to the target time.
Click the play button (often a '▶' icon, a 'Play' button, or the video screen itself) to start playback.

variants.do: Locate the speed selector (often labeled 'Speed', 'Playback Speed', or showing '1.0x'), click it, and select the desired multiplier.
Click along the progress bar timeline or drag the slider handle to the target timestamp before or during playback.

variants.when: the player is embedded in a video container
variants.do: Click directly on the video screen area to toggle play/pause.

watch_for: The play button changing to a pause icon ('❚❚' or similar).
The current time indicator or progress bar advancing.
A confirmation message or visual indicator showing the updated speed or setting.
completion_signal: The media player is actively playing with all requested settings (speed, timestamp, subtitles) applied.
pitfalls: Attempting to seek or change settings before the media player has fully loaded.
Accidentally clicking outside the progress bar when trying to seek, which might deselect the player or navigate away.
